newsitem.title: UK: C&W down on profit-taking, phone charge cuts.
newsitem.headline: C&W down on profit-taking, phone charge cuts.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless Plc dropped on Monday amid profit-taking after recent strong gains and as the company's Mercury unit said it would cut the cost of international phone calls, dealers said.

The stock was down 12p at 508-1/2 by 1524 GMT, after on Friday touching its highest level since May 1996, driven by an increase in Merrill Lynch's price target for the stock and renewed talk of global alliances in the telecoms business.
"It had a good run-up last week and there had been a bit of profit-taking," said one dealer, "and the cuts in international call charges would affect C&W more than most."
Earlier Mercury said it was cutting the cost of international calls to more than 25 destimations for most of its residential and small business customers.
